title: The long way back
lockedMessage: The cold turns you back at the stones. The ferryman holds nothing of yours; there's nothing at the end of the way worth the walk.
emptyHandedMessage: The cold turns you back at the stones. The way takes nothing with you: leave it in the grave chest first.
startMessage: You step between the stones. The cold comes up through your feet.
failMessage: The way back lets go of you.
winMessage: You walked the long way back in {time}. (Best: {best}.)
